name: warp-dissolve
title: Warp Dissolve
description: The outgoing scene melts and blurs into a flowing, domain-warped color field that then resolves into the incoming scene. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D noise field instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .wpd-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.
useWhen: Creative or music content where a melt reads as intentional.
avoidWhen: A very short cut: the melt needs about two and a half seconds.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Distortion
variables.description: How strongly the color field warps.

variables.label: Swirl
variables.description: How much the field twists around the center.

variables.label: Softness
variables.description: How soft the color transitions are.

variables.label: Colors
variables.description: Comma-separated hex colors the field moves through.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Multiplier for the field’s own drift.
